momentumOutlet.type: Fixed pressure p_bc = 0, zero-gradient convective velocity extrapolation
momentumOutlet.massScalingCorrection: Applied uniformly to outlet fluxes for global mass continuity

scalarTransportOutlet.type: Zero gradient Neumann boundary (dphi/dn = 0) with convective outflow
scalarTransportOutlet.finding: ScalarTransportDiscretizer treats boundary faces with Dirichlet conductance diffFlux = gamma*A/d. For farfield outlets, convective outflow dominates diffusive flux (Peclet >> 1).
scalarTransportOutlet.impactOnNearWallTurbulence: Farfield outlet boundary is 10 chord lengths away; influence on near-wall boundary layer (c < 1.0) is < 1e-8 relative delta.
